name: Harper Teamwork

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Reference-only: Help for an ally’s attack also gives that enemy Disadvantage on its first save before your next turn starts. After succeeding on a save ending your Frightened or Paralyzed, end the same condition on one visible ally within 30 feet.
